VISIT US FOR;

Physiotherapy for all musculoskeletal disorders and related injuries like muscle strains, sprairs, spondylosis, disc prolapse, spondylolisthesis and etc.

• All neurological disorders like Hemiplegia.
• Bell's Palsy, Facial palsy, Parkinsons, Muscular dystorphies etc.,
• Cardio and respiratory Physiotherapy for all related diseases.
• Rehabilitation for Cerebral palsy and other paediatric central nervous system disorders, like meningitis, Hydro cephalus and spinabifida.

Infrastructure for a better scope of rehabilitations.
